name: thin keeps a value whose time went backwards
about: A continuous value stamped earlier than the last one thin kept is kept, and the budget restarts from it, so a clock that restarts never silences the link.
notes: hz 10, so a value is kept when it is the first, when (t - t_kept) * 10 >= 1000, or when t is EARLIER than t_kept. Read as no time passed, a restarted clock would drop every value until it passed the old one.
t 400: earlier than 1000, so kept. t_kept 400. Read as elapsed 0 it would be dropped, and so would everything below up to t 1100.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 450: (450 - 400) * 10 = 500, dropped. The budget restarted from 400, not from 1000.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 500 again: (500 - 500) * 10 = 0, dropped. The same millisecond is not backwards.
